evals.expected_output: Seed: the Instagram reel Entry from a phone Capture (link only, fallback Category, Note set). It ends Processed with the post's content.
expectations: The reel Entry's Status is the Library's label for Processed and its Note is empty
Its Author is the account handle and its Caption holds the post's full caption
Its page body has a Transcript section, and an On-screen text section if the video shows text
Its Title is no longer the link or Capture's '<Platform> post' title
Its Category is a non-fallback Category when one fits the post
It has a page cover
The reply is in the Settings language and counts it as Processed

evals.expected_output: Seed: the TikTok Entry captured from a vm.tiktok.com short link. Its Link becomes the full post link, and it ends Processed.
expectations: The TikTok Entry's Link is https://www.tiktok.com/@<user>/video/<id> with no query string
Its Status is the Library's label for Processed
Its Caption and Author are filled

evals.expected_output: Seed: the YouTube Entry Capture already previewed. The Worker keeps its Title and adds the description and a transcript.
expectations: The YouTube Entry keeps the Title Capture wrote
Its Caption holds the video's description
Its page body has a Transcript section
Its Status is the Library's label for Processed

evals.expected_output: Seed: a Processed TikTok Entry, and a newer Inbox Entry holding a different vm.tiktok.com short link to the same video. The newer one is merged into the older one.
expectations: The newer Entry is in the Notion trash
The older Entry's page body gains a 'Captured again on <date>' line with the newer Entry's Captured date
The reply counts one merged Entry

expectations: The Entry's Status is the Library's label for Unavailable
Its Note says why, in the Settings language
No other field of the Entry changed

expectations: No Entry is created, changed or moved to the trash

evals.expected_output: Seed: an Inbox Entry whose Category the user set by hand to a non-fallback Category. The Worker keeps it.
